components.text: Makes the Valet Pike, the only weapon that hurts the Spirit of the Beast, and only in a direct blow. A full-moon night only, in a medium circle: iron, wolfsbane, mountain ash dust and sire's blood.
Only a witch type can work it. The blood must be an NPC Original's, or of a Hunter of the Five, an Alpha, an Original, a hybrid or a tribrid, or at rung 4 or higher of the vampire or werewolf ladder.

A refusal about the blood always reads the same and spends everything, so it cannot tell you what somebody is. A caster who is no witch type, or a night that is not a full moon night, gets everything back.
